# `tag-removed`

Tag removed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `docs` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `tag-removed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | Docs (annotations only) ([RULES.md section 10](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A tag was removed from the top-level `tags` list.

## Why this default

Documentation only (operation tags are `operation-tags-changed`).

## Example

From test case [`tag-removed`](../../test/cases/tag-removed/): A tag was removed from the top-level tags list.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
  tags:
  - name: pets
- - name: owners
  paths:
    '/pets':
```

Findings:

- `tag-removed` · info · document

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  tag-removed: info
```
